parameters.query: UPDATE dead_letter_events SET attempts=attempts+1,updated_at=now(),next_retry_at=now()+(LEAST(attempts,6)*10||' minutes')::interval WHERE id IN (SELECT id FROM dead_letter_events WHERE status='pending' AND attempts<6 AND COALESCE(next_retry_at,now())<=now() ORDER BY created_at LIMIT 50 FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED) RETURNING *;
